outcome: bounded implementation delivered for manager acceptance

criteria.criterion: Exact IDs, labels, aliases and lexical definitions retain deterministic order/reasons; duplicates remain distinct and aliases retain preferred identity.
Category/lifecycle filters apply before paging; one snapshot has no duplicate/skipped IDs and byte-limited empty output is explicitly incomplete.
Changing query, filters, direction, sort, project/root, snapshot, service instance or reading session invalidates a cursor; endpoint bounds never widen agent contracts.
Entry fields are faithful, missing sections are absent, deprecated history/replacement survives exact-ID access, and fact/lifecycle/freshness remain distinct.
Parallel relations retain individual IDs; incoming traversal does not reverse semantic direction; loops/cycles/high-degree data stay bounded with meaningful coverage.
No whole-project browser response is used for layout/start selection; list and map receive the same normalized records and omission semantics.
A source request cannot browse arbitrary paths or another record/project; recorded/current hashes and freshness are distinct.
Exact supported section/line/JSON locators yield precise evidence; unreliable extraction labels bounded excerpt; changed bytes remain visibly stale without repairing provenance.
Text is escaped, sizes are bounded, source bodies stay transient and no external link is fetched automatically.

Backend process sections follow the accepted exact configured identities, relation/source field support, ordered-source verification and missing/partial/stale states; UI rendering and keyboard/source-drawer acceptance remain explicit later TASK-016 obligations.
